title: Klavžar–Tian–Tuite complexity conjecture for Builder/Blocker games
statement:
Consider the Builder/Blocker games denoted by the B-game and B'-game, together with their decision versions. **Klavžar–Tian–Tuite's conjecture.** The decision versions of the B- and B'-games are PSPACE-complete.

The complexity of these decision problems was described as completely unknown before this conjecture. The conjectured PSPACE-completeness remains open.
source_name: Ullas Chandran S. V., Sandi Klavžar and James Tuite, “The General Position Problem: A Survey”, arXiv:2501.19385 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.19385

Status: **open** according to the source (as of January 2025). “Another open problem is given in the following conjectured Nordhaus-Gaddum relation.”
